subject.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this flatter card-based iOS phone Control tab after the newer native iOS Control/Talk work, or keep the current native List-based direction?
rationale: The implementation is a visual/product direction change for the default iPhone Control tab, the linked issue already carries product-decision labels, and current main has since landed overlapping native iOS design work.

options.title: Approve after rebase and proof
options.body: Require the contributor to rebase on current main, use OpenClawType, preserve current routing, add before/after simulator proof, and then review the visual direction.

options.title: Keep the current native direction
options.body: Close or narrow this PR and resolve the linked feature issue around the current List-based Control design instead of adding custom cards.

options.title: Sponsor a different design
options.body: Have an iOS owner define a smaller or different Control layout change that incorporates the useful Chat/Talk prominence idea without this branch shape.

recommendation.title: Approve after rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Require the contributor to rebase on current main, use OpenClawType, preserve current routing, add before/after simulator proof, and then review the visual direction.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete recently authored and merged overlapping iOS Control/Talk visual hierarchy work and merged the native iOS design changes that this PR must reconcile with.
